_: The weather on the town (weather_fx.gd; the finesse catalogue's shared facts; Manor Lords, Foundation). The wind (direction and strength) and the wetness (0 dry .. 1 soaked) are each one fact, set by the weather the bridge rolls, published as the shader globals wind and wet and as WeatherFx.wind / WeatherFx.wet for the rest (fire spread, smoke, grass, banners, the townsfolk). on: the town's weather dressing (or --weather=v2 / --weather=off): roofs (snow.gdshader as an overlay on the towns' building batches, never on people): wet roofs darker and glinting (roof.dark, roof.sheen), winter snow lying patchy on what faces the sky (roof.snow: how much of the season's ground snow the roofs carry; the season's ground snow is terrain.gd's). puddles: when wetter than from, puddles on the ground round the square (count, size: world units) and mud on the roads near the town (mud: how many spots, spacing along the road, size), drawn only for towns within near of the camera, fading in and out with the wet. home: in rain or a storm this share of the townsfolk who would be out go home instead (npc_mind villager branch). fire: a wet town's fire spreads slower, gaps times (1 + wet x slow).
